title: Long-time asymptotics of the Newell equation on the line
summary: In 1978, A. C. Newell [SIAM J. Appl. Math. 35(4) (1978) 650-664] proposed an exactly solvable model called Newell equation, which simulates the investigation of significant interaction mechanism between long and short waves. Nearly fifty years have passed, yet the long-time asymptotics of the Newell equation remains an open problem to date, with no results reported. In this work, the long-time asymptotic behaviors of the solutions to this model under Schwartz class initial conditions are studied by using the Riemann-Hilbert formulation.
